title: Diamond Hands
tagline: A tutorial and simple application using Chronicle Oracle with Scaffold-Eth.
description:
This is a tutorial which very specifically walks the user through setting up Scaffold-Eth-2 to be used with Chronicle Oracles on a Sepolia TestNet.
The user is guided through the setup of scaffold-eth, how to deploy the contract to a testnet, generate a burner wallet and obtain testnet tokens, and then integrate use cases for the Chronicle Oracle Scribe information.
how_its_made:
This uses the scaffold-eth-2 repository, openzeppelin opensource contracts, and information provided by test net smart contract addresses from Chronicle.
The application itself is a smart contract only which is accessible on Openlink Sepolia and can receive testnet funds, hold them in the contract, and release them when a condition is met matching the Chronicle Oracle information.
